cases.vacuous_proved_note: A verdict of Proved for (release_injective_digest, [alice]) would be vacuous-by-retirement. 99.6 percent of admitted pairs, 65280 of 65536, retire at the first release, step 9 of 18, under section 12 transition 1. The bit-7 divergence at steps 11 to 17 is therefore outside Secure^1_{A,e} for every secret-varying pair, and a reader of a bare verdict cannot tell that apart from a covered proof. This harness does not compute a ModelStatus, an NFConforms judgment, or a receipt; it records the statistic that part5-soundness.tex:210-219 says could ship now and stops there.

cases.vacuous_proved_note: This is the contrast side. Lanes that agree on bit 0 take section 12 transition 2, EqualAuthorized, and stay Active, so only 50.0 percent of admitted pairs retire and 16384 secret-varying pairs are still Active when the identical bit-7 divergence is reached. A verdict here would not be vacuous-by-retirement, which is the whole point of keeping the pair: without it the statistic could not be distinguished from a constant. This harness does not compute a ModelStatus for either side.
